author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Silent Lynx, a group likely based in Kazakhstan, targets Russian energy and government entities in espionage campaigns across Central Asia. title: Silent Lynx: Kazakhstan-Linked Hackers Target Russian Refinery and Government

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Spyware vendors use online ad infrastructure to profile targets and deliver exploits without requiring users to click anything. The investigation links Discover-Tech to Candiru, an Israeli spyware vendor that the US government placed on its Entity List in 2021. Candiru has since used the name Integrity Labs. title: AdFection: Beyond the Click: Citizen Lab Exposes Ad-Delivered Spyware Networks

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Attackers exploit a critical Cisco email gateway flaw to gain root access. Cisco urges customers to update scanner tools and check for compromise. title: Cisco Urges Customers to Patch Email Gateway Flaw and Check for Compromise

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Android trojan Hirudo replaces genuine banking apps with modified versions to steal credentials and bypass security checks, enabling financial fraud. title: Hirudo Android Trojan Replaces Banking Apps to Steal Credentials
